The '''''Peacemaker''-class cruiser''' was an ancient type of [[Starship/Legends|warship]] used by [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] explorers to travel between the worlds of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], during the pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] era. 

The Peacemaker was designed for long-term use and contained two sleeping quarters and a sitting area. Its standard armament was four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turrets. Most [[Je'daii Ranger]]s extensively customized their ships.<ref name="Into the Void" />
